alignments.note: Construct noun taking the supplied the, the rectum carrying a suffix and no article morpheme (rule 29).
Nomen rectum takes the of-relation and heads on the noun (rules 19, 24).

Partitive min takes the of the ASV writes for it (rule 11). It does not also take the both: rule 14 gives an opening correlative to another morpheme only where that morpheme is itself what the correlative says, as the min of a min ... 'ad range is, and a partitive preposition whose own of is written merely stands where both stands, which rule 14 says gives it no claim.
Construct noun of the superlative chain, rendered holy; the reverse division, most on the construct and holy on the rectum, is defensible and was the competing reading.
Article on the rectum takes the written the (rule 29).
The rectum of the superlative chain is what the ASV's most realizes.

The ASV renders this one connective morpheme by the correlative pair both ... and, so both English words belong to its single discontinuous unit, headed on the closing connective (rules 14, 25); the opening both is not added and is not the min's. The competing reading gives both to the first min on rule 14's exception, which reaches only a morpheme that is itself what the correlative says.
Subject pronoun and auxiliary belong to the verb (rule 17); head on the lexical verb.

review_notes: Corrected: both ... and is now one discontinuous unit on the waw, headed on and, and the first min keeps only its own of. Rule 14's default gives a correlative pair written for one connective morpheme to that morpheme; its exception hands the opening word to another morpheme only where that morpheme is itself what the correlative says, as the min of a min ... 'ad range is. Here the phrase is two parallel partitives, the ASV writes an of for each, and rule 14 states in terms that a morpheme merely standing where the opening correlative stands has no claim on it — the reasoning that leaves the two lamedhs of la-zakhar 'o la-neqevah without the whether.
The superlative qodshey ha-qodashim is divided most / holy between rectum and construct; the reverse division remains defensible and is named in the unit's note.
The article on ha-qodashim takes the the standing before its own word under rule 29, and the second min keeps its own of.
